sesnsp_municipal.name: Incidencia delictiva del fuero común, nivel municipal (nueva metodología) — Homicidio and Feminicidio rows
sesnsp_municipal.publisher: Secretariado Ejecutivo del Sistema Nacional de Seguridad Pública (SESNSP), via datos.gob.mx
sesnsp_municipal.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, as stated on datos.gob.mx)
sesnsp_municipal.notes: Counts of investigation files (carpetas de investigación) opened by state prosecutors, NOT victims. The source publishes monthly columns only; rows are kept monthly (year column = YYYY-MM); no annual sums were computed. Every modality (weapon) the source gives is kept. Homicidio culposo (non-intentional, mostly traffic) kept as its own measure because the source lists it under Homicidio; drop it if only intentional homicide is wanted. Codes 'x998 No Especificado' and 'x999 Otros Municipios' are source catch-all rows. data.csv is gzipped (data.csv.gz) because the uncompressed file is ~950 MB (4.4 million rows). Raw file is the filtered datastore JSON (gzipped), because the CSV host (repodatos.atdt.gob.mx) returns 403 Access Denied from this network.

sesnsp_victims_state.name: Víctimas del fuero común (nueva metodología) — Homicidio and Feminicidio rows
sesnsp_victims_state.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, as stated on datos.gob.mx)
sesnsp_victims_state.notes: Victim counts by state, monthly, broken down by weapon modality, sex (Hombre/Mujer/No identificado) and age group (0-17, 18+, not specified/not identified). Breakdown column = 'modality; sex; age'.

mujeres_homicidio_rate.notes: Rate per 100,000 WOMEN (the source's denominator), deaths by presumed homicide of women, from INEGI death statistics.

problems: geoBoundaries ADM2 has no INEGI codes, so municipalities were matched by name within their state (state found by placing each ADM2 shape in an ADM1 shape). 9 matched by hand to older/shorter names (e.g. 'Medellín de Bravo'->'Medellín', 'Batopilas de Manuel Gómez Morín'->'Batopilas', Oaxaca 'Mixtepec Distrito 08/22/26' -> '-Dto. 08 -' etc.). Unmatched = municipalities created after the geoBoundaries vintage (e.g. San Quintín, Puerto Morelos, new Chiapas/Guerrero/Morelos municipalities) plus source catch-all rows; their parent municipalities' shapes in geoBoundaries still include their territory. geoBoundaries ADM1 'Distrito Federal' carries shapeISO MX-MEX (a geoBoundaries error); matching used names, not ISO. SESNSP state-level incidence file (INM_estatal) not taken separately: its datos.gob.mx datastore actually holds the municipal table, and the CSV host blocks this network; state totals are recoverable from the municipal file.
